steps: On v0.102.3001 with ZoomIt enabled, open Chrome or Android Studio with vertical content.
Activate Scrolling Screenshot with the reporter configured shortcut and select a rectangle.
Scroll downward normally and record black frame, ZoomIt hang, and Windows Magnifier state.
Repeat in a second app and note whether exit/re-enable restores capture.
